title: Three places, one year
subtopic: S0 — Cold open: three places, one year
learning_goal: Know there are three specific places and one specific year in this film; feel handed something, not sold something.

narration.script: One street, three minutes end to end, and the world's word for made-to-measure. A house you could not buy into: you had to be elected. Every road sign in Britain that says LONDON means this spot. Six weeks before this story starts, the last gap in the wire closed. That autumn a novelist bet that the newly wired world could be circled in eighty days.
